issues.description: In solution_repository/src/de/tum/cit/ase/Lecture.java, the getters getLectureName() and getNumberOfInscribedStudents() are declared private, while the problem statement requires implementing getters for each attribute (intended as part of the class's public API and likely used by tests). This inconsistency can block students if they follow the solution's visibility and tests expect public getters.
issues.suggestedFix: Change getLectureName() and getNumberOfInscribedStudents() to public to match the required public getter API (and align with the other public getters).
